description: Read-only: inspect one exact ID from list_agents within this account. Unknown and other-account IDs are indistinguishable. Stale/offline data is last observed; loaded state becomes unknown. last_local_inference is a past uncached successful response/extraction on that model route in the agent process, not proof of current weights or load state. No model downloads, restarts or remote commands are executed.

agentId.description: Exact ID returned by list_agents; a hostname is not a verified agent ID.

title: Inspect my BrandBrain agent
